نرتوي (form VIII)
# نَرْتَوِي (nartawī) /nar.ta.wiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَوَى (irtawā)
# نَرْتَوِيَ (nartawiya) /nar.ta.wi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَوَى (irtawā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
